entities.summary: Xue Yuyang is a Chinese retired professional basketball player. Xue was selected 57th overall in the 2003 NBA draft by the Dallas Mavericks, who traded the pick to the Denver Nuggets. Xue is the only NBA player drafted whose surname begins with the letter X.
